title: QUIC RFC 9000 S4P6 Max Streams Oversized Close Policy Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S4P6 requirement-home tests over initial max_streams transport-parameter boundary handling and MAX_STREAMS oversized-frame close behavior, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the generated non-clean S4P6 max_streams oversized close-policy tail for RFC9000-S4-6-P2-S1-R01 and RFC9000-S4-6-P2-S2-R01.
expected_result: The focused tests show valid 2^60 initial max_streams transport-parameter values commit without closing, oversized typed initial max_streams values close with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR, valid 2^60 MAX_STREAMS frame values parse and format, and protected oversized MAX_STREAMS frames close with FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR.
procedure: Run the focused S4P6 hard-tail requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S4P6 MAX_STREAMS monotonic update tail remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0077.
The base stream-state model remains owned by ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim cumulative incoming-stream admission proof, metadata-only S4P6 xref cleanup, automatic stream-limit autotuning, public stream API widening, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred S4P6-0006 and S4P6-0007 fuzz expectations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S4P6-0006/0007 requirement-home filter 8/8, combined S4P6 hard-tail filter 11/11, Release build 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage at 1,304 of 1,771 trace-clean with S4P6-0006 and S4P6-0007 trace-clean, SpecTrace core validation 481 artifacts, full Release no-build suite 4,564/4,564, and git diff --check.
